_doc: iClone popups the watcher (scripts/ic8_watch.ps1) answers by itself. match = regex on the popup text (read by UIA, else screenshot + Windows OCR). press = button text. fresh_save_s = only press when the open project file was written less than this many seconds ago (so No never throws work away). Add a rule = add a line here; unknown popups are saved to ic8_jobs/dialogs/ as png + txt and left alone. press null = known progress window, ignore.

rules._note: progress windows: leave alone, no log

rules.match: physics memory is insufficient|may not run smoothly
custom expression key\(s\) which can not find

rules._note: after a crash: the saved .iProject is the truth; re-run steps after the last save (2026-11-21)
